programme.title: Boreale, Vivencias De Un Guía De Caza T6 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Penetramos en las transparentes aguas del embalse de Bolarque, en la provincia de Guadalajara. Este embalse, famoso durante muchos años por sus lucios, ha visto la llegada de la famosa perca europea o perca fluviatis, una especie muy deportiva que se ha sumado a las especies de este verdadero clásico del mar de Castilla.

programme.title: Beleza E Caça Dos Manetos
programme.desc: Mario se desplaza hasta la cordillera pirenaica en busca de diferentes especies.La caza y la gastronomía vuelven a ir de la mano.

programme.title: Predadores Em Buendía.
programme.desc: Javi Urbano se desplaza hasta la serranía de Cuenca para recechar distintas especies. El coto ubicado muy cerca del parque del Hosquillo, cuenta con ciervos, muflones, jabalíes y algo de macho montés.

programme.title: Súper Mario Boss T3 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: De la mano del Campeón Mundial de Pesca a Mosca, David Arcay, vamos a conocer la Galicia más auténtica en los entornos de los ríos más representativos de esta fantástica región del norte. David, pescando a mosca y a ninfa, nos mostrará cuál es el estado actual de las diferentes especies, sobresaliendo entre ellas una trucha esquiva, fuerte y sobre todo combativa.

programme.title: Recechando Después De La Berrea
programme.desc: Play Pesca es nuestro nuevo pódcast de pesca y naturaleza en Caza y Pesca TV. Odei Jainaga, un joven pescador vasco, invita a charlar a personajes destacados del mundo de la caña para sumergirse en una pasión compartida. 30 minutos de preguntas, respuestas, risas, anécdotas, recuerdos y sobre todo mucha, mucha pesca. Un cara a cara que despierta buen rollo.

programme.title: Monteando Entre Robles Y Chaparros
programme.desc: Unos de los aspectos más importantes en un perro de muestra son la guia y la muestra. Para ello son precisos los trucos que nuestro maestro, el adiestrador Manuel de la Iglesia, nos proporciona en este capítulo.

programme.title: Play Pesca T1 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: En este capítulo de Carnaza nos visita Juan Morillo, un padre de familia en busca de recetas fáciles y divertidas que poder compartir con los suyos. Junto a Iván cocinaremos la reina de nuestras aves de caza, la perdiz roja, creando dos platos fríos que no os dejarán indiferentes.

programme.title: Adiestrando Para La Caza T2 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: De la mano del Campeón Mundial de Pesca a Mosca, David Arcay, vamos a conocer la Galicia más auténtica en los entornos de los ríos más representativos de esta fantástica región del norte. David, pescando a mosca y a ninfa, nos mostrará cuál es el estado actual de las diferentes especies, sobresaliendo entre ellas una trucha esquiva, fuerte y sobre todo combativa.

programme.title: Os Segredos Do Arco T1 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: O rio Segre nunca mais foi o mesmo desde as inundações de 82, mas ainda oferece bons dias de pesca de trutas. O Luis e o Jordi são dois dos membros do clube de pesca do Alt Urgell, um dos mais antigos de Lérida, e pescam há mais de 30 anos.

programme.title: Galicia Enxebre Con David Arcay T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Não há ninguém mais sortudo do que aquele que faz coincidir o seu trabalho e a sua paixão. José Rodrigues é um homem de sorte. É pescador e também guia e produtor audiovisual especializado em pesca. Já pescou em todo o mundo mas a sua paixão é a carpa e mostra-nos isso neste fantástico reportagem.

programme.title: Trutas No Rio Segre
programme.desc: Conoceremos cómo seleccionar el mejor padre y la mejor madre para que tengamos éxito en nuestro cruce, junto con los primeros cuidados de los cachorros.

programme.title: As Carpas De Jose
programme.desc: El coto de Viana do Bolo se encuentra en la provincia de Orense, muy cerca de la frontera con Portugal y de las provincias de León y Zamora. Con grandes montes de castaño y roble el jabalí tiene asegurada la comida, permitiendo grandes batidas con muy buenos resultados.

programme.title: Adiestrando Para La Caza T2 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Viajamos até ao deserto de Chihuahua no México, na companhia de Josemaria Losa à procura de uma das espécies mais apreciadas que habita a zona, para um caçador de montanha, o desert big horn, ou borrego cimarron, esta e outras espécies deste deserto cheio de vida farão desta viagem uma experiência inesquecível.

programme.title: Caçadores De Javalis T6 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Viajamos a las montañas leonesas con los hermanos Lestrade, que decidieron celebrar el 80 aniversario de Michel cazando un rebeco cantábrico y descubriendo las bondades de la cocina montañesa.

programme.title: Galicia Enxebre Con David Arcay T2 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Deslocámo-nos para a zona da Aceitera e das lajes de Conil para praticar pesca subaquática numa das zonas mais ricas em peixe, mas também mais perigosa devido às correntes do Estreito. Um dia de pesca subaquática apaixonante.

programme.title: Marqués De Valdueza: Legado Montero
programme.desc: Diego Gallegos disfruta de una entretenida jornada de pesca en la costa malagueña, para posteriormente preparar un exquisito manjar en El Sollo.

programme.title: Marqués De Valdueza: Más Allá Del Título
programme.desc: José Boily es un entusiasta cazador y pescador canadiense de la provincia de Quebec que ha diseñado y protagonizado una serie de caza y de pesca que triunfa en Canadá y Francia en los últimos años. Probablemente la manera de cazar en la provincia de Quebec es la más similar a las técnicas europeas. Caza menor con perros de grouses o pequeños urogallos, o en puestos de patos, barnaclas o gansos blancos.

programme.title: Quebec A Vista De Pájaro T13 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Nuestro chef se desplaza hasta Colombia para visitar una de sus ganaderias tradicionales. Carne de lujo para elaborar sus mejores platos.

programme.title: Tórtola Europea, Éxito O Fracaso De Una Moratoria
programme.desc: La gastroacuaponía es una forma diferente de entender la cocina. Una actividad que integra y fusiona gastronomía con acuaponía.

programme.title: Carnaza T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Situado a sul dos Picos de Europa, as montanhas leonesas de Boñar albergam uma extraordinária diversidade de fauna incluindo espécies tão emblemáticas como o lobo ou o urogallo. Neste episódio. vamos viver, na companhia de jovens caçadores a caça ao veado na berreira, um espetáculo da natureza onde os grandes veados lutam para perpetuar a espécie.

programme.title: Cozinha Selvagem Com Diego Gallegos T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: La pesca en los estuarios donde se mezcla el agua dulce con la salada se convierte en esta serie, en todo un reto para la pesca. Desde kayak o desde orilla, con lluvia o al final del verano, nuestros protagonistas nos mostrarán las mejores técnicas y las localizaciones más oportunas para disfrutar de las especies deportivas del litoral gallego.

programme.title: Monteando Entre Robles Y Chaparros

programme.title: Spinning En Estuarios Gallegos T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Uma equipa do canal Caça e Pesca continua o seu périplo pela Amazónia Boliviana. Vamos percorrer, com os guias locais, a infinidade de meandros que o rio Curixá tem, um afluente do caudaloso Itenez, onde vamos explorar novas zonas de pesca.

programme.title: O Atum De Ponta A Ponta T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Segunda parte de la monteria celebrada en el Coto Nieblas donde 11 monteros ubicados en torretas disfrutaron de los lances a venados, gamos, muflones y jabalies.

programme.title: Os Segredos Do Arco T1 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Voltamos junto dos nossos amigos, pescadores que vivem a sua paixão pelo atum com uma intensidade fora do normal. Bom ambiente, amizade e vontade juntam-se num dia em que a paciência e a esperança acabam por dar frutos. A tão esperada picada chega e demonstra que, muitas vezes, o sucesso não é mais do que a recompensa por não deixar de tentar.

programme.title: Súper Mario Boss T3 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Viajámos para o arquipélago de Bazaruto para desfrutar de bons dias de pesca a popping e jigging. As águas turquesa esperam-nos com os exemplares mais combativos do mar de Moçambique.

programme.title: Chihuahua Um Deserto Vivo
programme.desc: Luis Cano, un apasionado cazador de la perdiz roja, acompañado de sus inseparables bretones y dos buenos amigos, disfruta de una fantástica jornada de caza en una de las mejores fincas para la caza de la perdiz roja al salto con perro de muestra.

programme.title: Moçambique, Paraíso Do Popping E Do Jigging
programme.desc: Una familia extremeña, gran aficionada a la caza menor sube de forma habitual todos los años a las ya famosas tiradas de palomas en la provincia de Madrid.

programme.title: Perdiceros En El Bonillo
programme.desc: Dejar las piezas cazadas en el campo por imposibilidad de cobro por parte de nuestros perros no es ético, por tanto conocer cómo educar en el rastro es fundamental.

programme.title: As Receitas Simples De Mary T2 - Ep. 21
programme.desc: Mary Berg está a preparar receitas de baixo esforço que cozinham lentamente, começando com porchetta e depois sanduíches de porchetta com maionese de alcaparras e ervas aromáticas; Mary prepara abóbora assada lentamente e um assado clássico.

programme.title: The Dog Academy T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Milo “relâmpago”, um cruzado de labrador, está a deixar a tutora, Melissa, de bofes na boca. Sempre que ela o chama, ele sai a disparado; velocista canino é demasiado intenso para ela conseguir controlar.

programme.title: Comer Pelo Mundo T1 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Programa de viagens gastronómicas apresentado por Verónica Zumalacárregui que nos traz a cozinha de cidades de todo o mundo ao entrar em contacto com os protagonistas locais que acabam por funcionar como cicerones de exceção. Neste episódio Verónica viaja até Nova Iorque.

programme.title: Fire Masters T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: O júri fica com uma espinha atravessada com os chefs na Ronda Wildfire. Não há caroço que não seja plantado enquanto os chefs se defrontam na Ronda Crossfire. O Feast of Fire traz-nos a comida beijada pelo fogo de Nova Orleães.

programme.title: Copshop Não Fazemos Prisioneiros
programme.desc: Em fuga de um assassino implacável, um astuto vigarista provoca distúrbios numa cidade pequena para ser preso e assim ficar escondido na esquadra da polícia. Só que o criminoso também acaba por ser preso numa cela próxima e a chegada de um terceiro assassino torna a situação ainda mais explosiva.

programme.title: Kickboxer - A Vingança
programme.desc: O campeão de kickboxing Eric Sloane aceita participar numa luta ilegal de Muay Thai na Tailândia mas morre às mãos do implacável Tong Po. Kurt, o seu irmão mais novo, jura vingá-lo e é treinado por Durand para conseguir sobreviver à batalha final contra o mortífero lutador.

programme.title: Extremamente Perverso, Escandalosamente Cruel E Vil
programme.desc: Ted é um homem bonito, inteligente e afetuoso. Liz é uma mãe solteira, cautelosa, mas apaixonada. Imagem da felicidade doméstica, a vida deste casal parece perfeita até ele ser preso e acusado de vários assassínios tenebrosos. Ele é Ted Bundy e torna-se o serial-killer mais famoso da América.

programme.title: O Homem Do Tai Chi
programme.desc: O talento sem paralelo para o Tai Chi de um jovem perito em artes marciais vale-lhe a entrada num clube de combate do submundo altamente lucrativo.

programme.title: Diabolik
programme.desc: A história sombria e romântica do primeiro encontro entre o mestre ladrão Diabolik e a sedutora Eva Kant, no final da década de 1960, com o inspetor Ginko determinado a acabar com os planos do larápio, que desta feita tenta roubar um valioso diamante.

programme.title: É A Vida
programme.desc: Após um primeiro encontro desastroso, Holly e Eric nunca mais querem voltar a ver-se. Mas quando Sophie, a afilhada de ambos, perde os pais num acidente, eles vão ter de colocar as suas diferenças de lado para educar a criança e conseguir viver sob o mesmo teto.

programme.title: Dunkirk
programme.desc: Mais de 300 mil soldados aliados da Bélgica, do Império Britânico e da França são cercados pelo exército alemão e evacuados da zona costeira de Dunquerque durante a Segunda Guerra Mundial.

programme.title: Na Lista Do Assassino
programme.desc: O polícia “Dirty” Harry Callahan tem como missão travar um jogo secreto e doentio cujo objetivo é assassinar celebridades e em que um dos alvos é ele próprio.

programme.title: Tubarão Branco
programme.desc: Quando um hidroavião aterra numa praia do remoto Recife do Inferno, o desastre acontece e os cinco passageiros ficam presos num bote salva-vidas insuflável, frágil e com abastecimentos limitados. No meio desta confusão, um enorme e furtivo tubarão branco já captou o cheiro deles.

programme.title: Fortaleza Segurança Máxima
programme.desc: Semanas após o mortífero ataque ao Campo Fortaleza, Robert faz uma ousada tentativa para resgatar a viúva do seu antigo inimigo Balzary. E enquanto um novo ataque ameaça a estabilidade daquele espaço, Robert é obrigado a encontrar-se com alguém que nunca mais esperava voltar a ver...

programme.title: Impacto Mortífero
programme.desc: Steve Wakes é um detetive da polícia determinado a encontrar o assassino que lhe matou o parceiro, num tiroteio que atingiu Madison, uma testemunha essencial no processo. Só que o seu grande receio confirma-se: os assassinos são dois polícias corruptos dispostos a tudo para encobrir o crime…

programme.title: Sem Hora Marcada
programme.desc: Uma jovem a tirar fotografias na natureza testemunha sem querer o assassínio de um traficante por uma polícia e vê-se envolvida numa conspiração que envolve agentes corruptos. Em fuga pela vida, a única pessoa que lhe pode valer é um velho oficial reformado.

programme.title: Le Chant Du Loup - Ameaça Em Alto Mar
programme.desc: Chanteraide tem o raro dom de conseguir identificar todos os sons que ouve. A bordo de um submarino nuclear francês, tudo depende dele, só que, reputado como infalível, ele acaba por cometer um erro que coloca toda a equipa em perigo de morte.

programme.title: O Homem Do Tai Chi
programme.desc: O talento sem paralelo para o Tai Chi de um jovem perito em artes marciais vale-lhe a entrada num clube de combate do submundo altamente lucrativo.

programme.title: Fim De Turno
programme.desc: Na zona de South Central em Los Angeles, os polícias Brian Taylor e Mike Zavala estabelecem uma poderosa amizade para garantir que regressam sempre ambos a casa no ´Fim do Turno´. Mas quando uma operação dá para o torto, tornam-se alvos a abater por um dos mais violentos carteis da região.

programme.title: Duelo Na Poeira
programme.desc: Novo México, 1881. Pat Garrett, antigo bandido agora ao serviço da lei, é encarregado de capturar o seu velho amigo Billy the Kid. Entre a lealdade e o dever, os dois enfrentam-se num Oeste que já não tem lugar para homens como eles.

programme.title: À Margem Da Lei
programme.desc: Quando um ex-detective descobre que o filho foi assassinado, ele regressa às ruas que outrora tão bem conhecia para tentar saber a verdade. Armado, perigoso e sem nada a perder, ele vai enfrentar um implacável mafioso local na busca de vingança.

programme.title: Mojin E O Templo Perdido
programme.desc: No início da década de 90, o famoso explorador de túmulos Hu Bayi decidiu reformar-se com a sua noiva, Shirley, mas são convencidos a regressar às lides por uma mulher misteriosa, que quer descobrir o túmulo de uma princesa mongol para possuir um artefacto que tem o poder de ressuscitar os mortos.

programme.title: Arcadian - Invasão Sombria
programme.desc: Num futuro em que maioria da civilização foi dizimada por um pandemia, Paul e os seus filhos gémeos lutam pela sobrevivência numa quinta fortificada.

programme.title: Gone - 12 Horas Para Viver
programme.desc: Jill Parrish está convencida que Molly, a sua irmã desaparecida, foi sequestrada pelo mesmo assassino em série de quem escapou no ano anterior. Mas será que Jill se encontra psicologicamente perturbada ou é a única que conhece a verdade, conseguindo encontrar Molly antes que seja tarde demais?

programme.title: Extremamente Perverso, Escandalosamente Cruel E Vil
programme.desc: Ted é um homem bonito, inteligente e afetuoso. Liz é uma mãe solteira, cautelosa, mas apaixonada. Imagem da felicidade doméstica, a vida deste casal parece perfeita até ele ser preso e acusado de vários assassínios tenebrosos. Ele é Ted Bundy e torna-se o serial-killer mais famoso da América.

programme.title: Terminal
programme.desc: Dois assassinos com uma missão sinistra, um professor com uma doença terminal, um empregado da limpeza enigmático e uma empregada de mesa com uma vida dupla vão ver os seus caminhos cruzarem-se de forma inesperada, e o destino de todos será decidido por um génio do crime em busca de vingança.

programme.title: Terra De Ninguém
programme.desc: Bill Greer e o seu filho Jackson estão de patrulha às suas terras na fronteira dos EUA quando este mata acidentalmente um jovem imigrante mexicano. Jackson foge a cavalo para o México, onde percorre desertos e montanhas em busca do perdão do pai do rapaz que matou, que jurou vingar-se dele.

programme.title: Sociedade Secreta
programme.desc: Um aluno de uma faculdade de elite, que depende de bolsas de estudo e trabalha em simultâneo, é aceite na sociedade secreta e ultra-exclusiva The Skulls, só que a promessa de ascensão social que lhe está associada faz-se em troca de um preço muito alto.

programme.title: Fortaleza
programme.desc: Robert vive numa espécie de estância natural criada para oficiais reformados dos serviços secretos dos EUA. Quando um grupo de criminosos invade o complexo com intenções de o matar, ele vai ter de encontrar um modo de proteger as vidas de todos os que lá se encontram.

programme.title: Missão Inesperada
programme.desc: Jim Hanson, um ex-atirador de elite do exército, vive junto à isolada fronteira entre os EUA e o México e torna-se inesperadamente o protetor de um menino mexicano, quando um perigoso cartel de droga mata a mãe do rapaz e os começa a perseguir de forma implacável.

programme.title: A Memória De Um Assassino
programme.desc: Alex Lewis é um assassino profissional que se recusa a completar a missão de matar uma criança, o que o torna num alvo a abater. A sua única hipótese é perseguir aqueles que o querem matar, só que ele tem um desafio quase inultrapassável: está a perder a memória a um ritmo cada vez mais acelerado.

programme.title: Rupture: Superando O Medo
programme.desc: Renée Morgan é uma mãe solteira que tenta libertar-se a todo o custo da organização misteriosa que a raptou e mantém presa e que a usa como cobaia de horríveis experiências.

programme.title: Meia-noite Em Switchgrass
programme.desc: Dois agentes do FBI a investigar uma rede de tráfico sexual cruzam-se com uma série de casos de homicídios de mulheres na Florida. Quando uma missão infiltrada dá para o torto e a própria agente é raptada, um oficial daquele estado tem poucas horas para a libertar e apanhar o brutal criminoso.

programme.title: Misha Fomin at the Concertgebouw 2018
programme.desc: Musical critics from North America, Europe, and Russia praise Nalchik-born pianist Misha Fomin for his subtlety of touch and phrasing. He graduated cum laude from the Gnessin’s Russian Academy of Music, Moscow, where he studied with Lina Bulatova, a former student of professor Helen Gnessina and legendary Heinrich Neuhaus, and later continued his musical studies at the Hochschule für Musik “Franz Liszt” in Weimar.

programme.title: Veerhavenconcert 2018
programme.desc: The Veerhavenconcert is a classical open-air concert held every year in the attractive harbor of Rotterdam. Little boats and ships float on the water next to a transparent stage flanked by antique sailboats. In this edition from 2018, the Veerhavenconcert offers an accessible program with operatic works by Verdi, Ponchielli, and Puccini. Maxim Emelyanchec leads the Dutch Philharmonic Orchestra and the Toonkunst Amsterdam choir.

programme.title: In the Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: This episode of the series 'In the Artist's Workshop' features a masterclass by French classical pianist Philippe Cassard in the works of Claude Debussy.

programme.title: Symphony No. 5
programme.desc: Composed between 1901 and 1902, Mahler's Fifth Symphony marked a significant shift in his compositional style, moving away from vocal elements toward a purely symphonic structure. It's a work of immense scope and emotional depth, known for its rich orchestral textures and intricate counterpoint.

programme.title: Berg - Piano Sonata, Op. 1
programme.desc: Italian pianist Andrea Molteni (1998) performs Alban Berg’s Piano Sonata in B minor, Op. 1. Molteni began studying the piano at the age of six. He graduated with honors and honorable mention at the Conservatorio di musica Giuseppe Verdi di Como, and was awarded a master’s degree Magna cum Laude in Advanced Performance Studies by the Conservatorio della Svizzera Italiana in Lugano.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mahler - Das Lied von der Erde
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra in Gustav Mahler’s poignant song cycle ‘Das Lied von der Erde’ (The Song of the Earth). Joining him are two of today's leading vocalists: mezzo-soprano Magdalena Kožená and tenor Andrew Staples. Written in the final years of his life, Mahler’s masterpiece contemplates the beauty of life and the sorrow of parting through some of his most personal and beautiful symphonic writing.

programme.title: Prokofiev - Peter and the Wolf
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Sergei Prokofiev’s Peter and the Wolf, Op. 67. Written in 1936, Peter and the Wolf is a short, narrated orchestral suite, telling the story of a brave boy named Peter, who lives with his grandfather on the edge of a forest.

programme.title: Chamber music by Mozart and Shostakovich
programme.desc: French violinist Renaud Capuçon appears at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, presenting a chamber music program consisting of classical and 20th century repertoire. He performs with the soloists of the International Menuhin Music Academy led by French conductor Jean-Jacques Kantorow. First on the program is Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Sinfonia Concertante in E-flat major, K.

programme.title: Schubert - Rondo D. 951
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists. As part of this concert, Argerich and pianist Iddo Bar-Shaï perform Franz Schubert’s Rondo in A major, D. 951.

programme.title: The Three Lives of Clara Schumann
programme.desc: The documentary “The Three Lives of Clara Schumann” traces the fascinating life story of German pianist and composer Clara Schumann. Born Clara Wieck in Leipzig in 1819, she was an exceptionally talented pianist, with an impressive international music career. She first met Robert Schumann, whom she married in 1840 and eventually had eight children with, in 1828.

programme.title: Ravel - La Valse
programme.desc: The exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a performance of Maurice Ravel’s La Valse, in an arrangement for two pianos. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021.

programme.title: Patmos – A musical documentary
programme.desc: Every summer, the Greek island of Patmos hosts the Patmos Musical Festival, a unique musical event comprising both a Chamber and a Sacred Music Festival. This documentary captures the 2024 edition, featuring performances by distinguished soloists and ensembles from around the world.

programme.title: Liszt - Elegies No. 1 and 2 (S. 130 And 131)
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform Franz Liszt’s Two Elegies for cello and piano. This performance was recorded at Sala Verdi of the Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi in Milan, Italy, on November 4, 2024.

programme.title: Dvorák – Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 1–8)
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in Antonín Dvorák’s spirited Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 1-8). These 16 folk dances earned Dvorák, who was a relative newcomer when he wrote them, great success. Originally composed for piano four hands, the London Symphony Orchestra plays the orchestral version of these brilliant works. This performance was recorded at LSO St.

programme.title: Roberto Giordano plays Brahms and Beethoven
programme.desc: In this recital, Roberto Giordano plays the Six Pieces for Piano, op. 118 of Brahms, a collection completed in 1893 and dedicated to Clara Schumann who will be the penultimate produced by the composer during his lifetime. The concert program also includes two Beethoven sonatas, the famous Moonlight Sonata No. 14, op. 27, and Sonata No. 31, op. 110, one of the last sonatas signed by the composer.

programme.title: Bach - Preludes and Fugues And Alla variata BWV 989
programme.desc: At the age of eleven, Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti (*1977) debuted with Italian chamber orchestra I Solisti Veneti under the baton of Claudio Scimone. He performed on international festivals and in prestigious concert halls worldwide. Besides, he appeared with several renowned orchestras such as Lucerne Festival Strings, Camerata Salzburg, and Prague Chamber Orchestra. In this recital, Bacchetti performs works of J. S. Bach.

programme.title: Misha Fomin at the Concertgebouw
programme.desc: Since his spectacular debut recital at the Amsterdam Concertgebouw in 2002, pianist Misha Fomin has become an indispensable part of Dutch musical life. National and international press praise his playing for its fluently natural virtuosity, rich color palette, and great musical intelligence.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 2
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Preludes - Danze al pianoforte
programme.desc: In multidisciplinary project ‘Preludes - Danze al pianoforte’, dance and music come together in a wonderful and sophisticated show. Recognized Italian choreographer Massimo Moricone choreographed some of the most beautiful piano pieces by Frédéric Chopin, Claude Debussy, J. S. Bach, and Sergei Rachmaninoff, played by Italian pianist Costanza Principe.

programme.title: Works for violin and piano: Mozart, Beethoven a.o.
programme.desc: On the occasion of International Women’s Day, Italian violinist Laura Marzadori and Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti performed a wonderful concert at Teatro Sociale di Camogli, Italy. On the program are Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Sonata No. 18 in G major, K. 301; Ludwig van Beethoven’s Sonata No. 5 in F major, Op.

programme.title: The Galileo Project: Music of the Spheres
programme.desc: The Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra, also known simply as Tafelmusik, is a Toronto-based Canadian baroque orchestra, specialised in early music. The ensemble is directed by violinist Jeanne Lamon. In ‘The Galileo Project: Music of the Spheres’ they perform music by Monteverdi, Vivaldi, Bach and Handel to a backdrop of high-definition images from the Hubble telescope, NASA and Canadian astronomers.

programme.title: Liszt - Due Poemi Sinfonici
programme.desc: Franz Liszt (1811 - 1886) composed 13 symphonic poems, largely inspired by literary texts. The composer himself wrote piano duet arrangements for these pieces, showcasing his incredible ability of imitating a full orchestra on the piano. Liszt, one of the 19th century’s most important piano virtuosos, strongly influenced the further development of piano music.

programme.title: Copland - Appalachian Spring
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Aaron Copland’s Appalachian Spring Suite. Originally commissioned as a ballet for the legendary dancer Martha Graham, Aaron Copland's Appalachian Spring (1944) has since become an American classic. While first scored for a thirteen-piece ensemble, Copland later arranged the work for a full orchestra.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 1 in G minor, Op. 13
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen leads Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 1 in G minor, Op. 13, ‘Winter Daydreams’, recorded at De Doelen in Rotterdam, the Netherlands in September 2022. Having completed a number of shorter orchestral works, Tchaikovsky embarked on a more ambitious project in March 1866: to write his first symphony.

programme.title: Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète
programme.desc: The documentary “Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète” (2017) tells the remarkable life story of Romanian pianist Clara Haskil (1895-1960). Born in Bucharest into a Jewish family, she began her career as a child prodigy, entering the Bucharest Conservatory at a very young age. She continued her music studies in Vienna and Paris. Haskil suffered from chronic health issues and lived through two world wars, which held back her career.

programme.title: A Tribute to Vienna
programme.desc: Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna in this March 9, 2011 concert from Vienna's Café Sperl. The ensemble, which consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic, performs arrangements of five popular waltzes by Johann Straus II. Among them are Kaiser-Walzer, Op. 437, and Schatz-Walzer, Op. 418, from the operetta The Gypsy Baron.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 5, 'Emperor'
programme.desc: Italian conductor Gianandrea Noseda leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 5 in E-flat major, Op. 73, famously known as the ‘Emperor’ Concerto. Italian pianist Beatrice Rana features as the soloist here. The New York Times describes her as ‘one of the most insightful and prodigiously gifted artists of the new generation’.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 6
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 6 is a monumental work exploring deep personal tragedy, incorporating a unique, famous 'hammer' blows that symbolize the inevitable blows of fate. This symphony's intense emotional power, epic scope, and the composer's eventual wrestling with fate and personal loss make it an unforgettable, profoundly moving experience for audiences.

programme.title: In the Organ's Stomach
programme.desc: Olivier Latry is the current holder of the Great Organ of Notre Dame. Between its original religious function and the interest of composers of all times, the great organ Cavaillé-Coll reveals its absolute modernity. Latry is considered one of the greatest organists of his generation, both in France and internationally.

programme.title: Dvorák - Rusalka
programme.desc: Bulgarian conductor Pavel Baleff conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Opéra de Limoges in a performance of Antonín Dvorák’s lyric fairytale opera Rusalka (1900). The work’s libretto is written by Czech poet Jaroslav Kvapil. Rusalka, an elusive water nymph, falls in love with the Prince, who happens to swim in her lake. Rusalka longs to become human herself so that she can be together with the Prince.

programme.title: Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 3, Op. 14
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Schumann composed his Piano Sonata No. 3 in F minor, Op. 14 (a 'Concerto for piano without orchestra', in the words of music publisher Tobias Haslinger) in 1836. He dedicated it to piano virtuoso Ignaz Moscheles.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: IVC 2019 - Final: Duparc, Borodin et al.
programme.desc: Mezzo-soprano Esther Valentin (Germany, 1993) and pianist Anastasia Grishutina (Russia, 1988) perform Henri Duparc’s L’invitation au voyage; Aleksandr Borodin’s ‘Dlya beregov otchizni dal’noy’ (For the shores of thy far native land); ‘Fleur jetée’ from Gabriel Fauré’s Quatre melodies, Op. 39; Franz Schubert’s Die Liebe hat gelogen, Op. 23 No. 1 (D.

programme.title: Martinu° - Concertino for Piano Trio and Strings
programme.desc: The Italian-Swiss ensemble Trio des Alpes, consisting of Hana Kotková (violin), Claude Hauri (cello), and Corrado Greco (piano), and the Orchestra da Camera di Mantova join forces in this performance of the Concertino for Piano Trio and String Orchestra, H. 232 by Czech composer Bohuslav Martin (1890-1959). Martin was a prolific composer, creating an oeuvre of almost 400 works.

programme.title: Works for cello and piano by Schumann, Chopin a.o.
programme.desc: In Geneva, the Swiss city where she has spent most of her life, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich invites her lifelong music partner, the cellist Mischa Maisky, to play chamber music. Between the pieces, Martha opens up to her daughter Annie Dutoit in an intimate interview that addresses both their relationship and the music.

programme.title: Mozart - Quintet for piano and winds, K. 452
programme.desc: Luca Vignali (oboe), Angelo De Angelis (clarinet), Carmine Pinto (horn), Eliseo Smordoni (bassoon), and Linda Di Carlo (piano) perform Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Quintet for piano and winds in E-flat major, K. 452. The work premiered at the Viennese Burgtheater on April 1, 1784, with the composer himself at the piano. Shortly after the performance, Mozart wrote to his father Leopold, “I consider it the best work I have ever written…”.

programme.title: Nine Symphonies That Changed the World
programme.desc: Founded by Daniel Barenboim and Edward Said, the West-Eastern Divan Orchestra is composed of young musicians from Israel, Palestine, several other Arab countries, and Spain. The musicians band together at least once a year to rehearse and perform on stage, where their shared love of music crosses national, ethnic, and religious boundaries.

programme.title: Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 2 in G minor, Op. 22
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Piano Sonata No. 2 in G minor, Op. 22. The composer completed the work in 1838. Of Schumann’s three piano sonatas, Piano Sonata No. 2 is performed and recorded most frequently.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: Mahler's 'Resurrection' Symphony, written between 1888 and 1894, is a colossal five-movement work exploring themes of death and resurrection. It was one of Mahler's most popular and acclaimed works during his lifetime, famously culminating in a powerful choral finale.

programme.title: In the Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: This episode of the series 'In the Artist's Workshop' features a masterclass by French classical pianist Philippe Cassard in the works of Claude Debussy.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky – Violin Concerto, Op. 35
programme.desc: Dutch violinist Simone Lamsma brings lyricism and fire to Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s virtuosic Violin Concerto, joining conductor Gianandrea Noseda and the London Symphony Orchestra. Tchaikovsky wrote the piece in 1878 on the shores of Lake Geneva, collaborating closely with his former student and lover, violinist Iosif Kotek.

programme.title: Schumann - Kreisleriana, Op. 16
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Kreisleriana, Op. 16. Schumann claimed that he penned this 1838 composition in just four days. He dedicated it to Frédéric Chopin, his contemporary.

programme.title: Ravel - Ma mère l'Oye
programme.desc: At the behest of Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich, several classical music stars took part in this concert in aid of the Erasmus Fund for medical research in intensive care, recorded at the Royal Conservatory of Brussels, Belgium, on October 21, 2023. The concert pays tribute to the renowned cellist Aleksandr Khramouchin (1979) who suddenly passed away on May 13, 2023.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 9, a profoundly emotional and technically complex work from 1909-1910, is characterized by its sprawling, late-Romantic style, exploring themes of human experience, love, and existential questions against the backdrop of Mahler's own impending death.

programme.title: Prokofiev - Peter and the Wolf
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Sergei Prokofiev’s Peter and the Wolf, Op. 67. Written in 1936, Peter and the Wolf is a short, narrated orchestral suite, telling the story of a brave boy named Peter, who lives with his grandfather on the edge of a forest.

programme.title: Romeo and Juliet
programme.desc: Sergei Prokofiev based his ballet ‘Romeo and Juliet’ on William Shakespeare's famous play of the same name, telling the story of two young lovers from the feuding families Montague and Capulet. Acclaimed French choreographer Jean-Christophe Maillot created a distinctive choreography of the ballet in 1996, which has been performed to great success the world over.

programme.title: Mosaïque Project - Canadian Piano Quartets
programme.desc: This very special concert event celebrates the diversity and richness of Canada through the eyes and ears of its people. Ensemble Made in Canada’s Mosaique Project features a commissioned suite of piano quartets by 14 Canadian composers, each inspired by a region of our vast country. Their album release and two-year National tour culminate in St. Catharines’ stunning Partridge Hall!

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 25 And Symphony No. 35
programme.desc: Stefano Conticello leads the Orchestra of Teatro Comunale di Bologna in a Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart program. The concert opens with the Overture from Mozart’s popular opera “The Magic Flute”. This is followed by Piano Concerto No. 25 in C major, K. 503, with Maurizio Baglini as the featured soloist. Mozart’s Piano Concerto No. 25 is just one of the twelve great piano concertos he composed during 1784 and 1786.

programme.title: Schumann - Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz performs Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26 (Carnival Scenes from Vienna).

programme.title: Debussy - La Mer
programme.desc: Claude Debussy’s symphonic sketches for orchestra known collectively as ‘La Mer’ evoke a richly varied vision of the sea. The first part (‘De l’aube á midi sur la mer’) calls up a morning and afternoon at sea, the second (‘Jeux de vagues’) echoes the play of the waves, and the third and final part (‘Dialogue du vent et de la mer’) conjures the communing voices of wind and waves.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Chopin - Piano Concertos No. 1 And No. 2
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21. Soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin. After performing the first concerto, Demidenko encores with Chopin's Mazurka Op. 17/4. Kissin closes the concert with Chopin's Etude Op. 10/12 and the Waltz in E minor, Op. post. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 1, Op. 15
programme.desc: At the age of seven, Martha Argerich made her debut with Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 1, a piece that would accompany her throughout her career. In this concert at the Lucerne Festival, the celebrated pianist performs the signature piece with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra under the baton of Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt, who made his debut here with the orchestra.

programme.title: Chopin - Piano Concerto No. 2, Op. 21
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performance of Frédéric Chopin's Piano Concerto No. 2, Op. 21. Evgeny Kissin features as the soloist. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010. Chopin composed the second concerto one year before the Concerto No. 1 and completed both works at the age of 20, before leaving his home country Poland and moving to Paris.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphonies and Piano Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra (BFO) in a concert program dedicated to the music of Ludwig van Beethoven. The program opens with the composer’s Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. Afterward, Fischer conducts Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 4 in G major, Op. 58, in which Richard Goode features as the soloist. The acclaimed American pianist (1943) is known for his interpretations of the Beethoven repertoire.

programme.title: Welser-Möst conducts Farrenc, Ravel And Mussorgsky
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a program recorded at Severance Music Center in Cleveland in March 2023. On the program are Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G (featuring Vïkingur Ólafsson as soloist) and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition (orchestration by Ravel).

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Esa-Pekka Salonen
programme.desc: The Finnish composer and conductor Esa-Pekka Salonen (1958) was Music Director of the Los Angeles Philharmonic from 1992 until 2009. Under his dynamic leadership, it was recognized as one of the world's most outstanding orchestras. The exciting musical partnership Salonen established with his musicians was widely acclaimed in the international press.

programme.title: Mahler - The Song of Lamentation
programme.desc: Mexican conductor José Areán leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería and four vocal soloists in a performance of Gustav Mahler’s cantata ‘The Song of Lamentation’ (Das klagende Lied). Among the soloists are soprano Sally Dibblee, mezzo-soprano Marjorie Elinor Dix, tenor Arturo Chacón, and bass Stephen West.

programme.title: Novo Dia
programme.desc: Queremos que os portugueses comecem o dia bem informados, na companhia da CNN Portugal. Em direto e a partir dos estúdios de Lisboa e do Porto, vamos estar de olhos postos em tudo o que acontece no continente, nas ilhas, em todas as geografias.

programme.title: Documentário: Chefe Do Ano 2026
programme.desc: Há 36 anos que a mesma pergunta atravessa as cozinhas de Portugal: quem é o Chefe do Ano? Mais do que um concurso, é o palco onde um sonho se transforma em legado, o mesmo que revelou nomes hoje incontornáveis na gastronomia portuguesa, todos eles, um dia, apenas cozinheiros e cozinheiras com uma faca, uma ideia e a coragem de arriscar tudo.Este documentário entra nas cozinhas e nos bastidores, nas mãos que tremem antes do prato...

programme.desc: 'Ultraje' é uma viagem vibrante pelo coração da identidade portuguesa. programme.title: Feira Semanal: Caldas Da Rainha

O centro da cidade enche-se de bancas repletas de fruta acabada de colher, legumes que ainda cheiram a terra e mãos sábias que conhecem cada estação do ano. Neste episódio do 'Feira Semanal', entramos numa feira muito antiga, onde quase tudo o que se vende, vem diretamente do campo.

programme.title: Texas Metal T2 - Ep. 2

programme.desc: Ressurreição conta a história da tribo Kayi, uma das tribos turcas que se afastaram das estepes da Ásia Central e que chegou aos territórios da Anatólia. Ertugrul, que tem os seus objetivos, e não tem medo de morrer pela sua religião, pela sua terra natal e pela sua família, luta contra o poder imperial do seu tempo com uma estrutura inteligente e visionária.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 30
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 31
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Meu Campeão - Ep. 50
programme.desc: Kafkas, um jovem pugilista promissor, tem sua vida virada de cabeça para baixo com um infeliz incidente que o força a abandonar a carreira e se despedir dos ringues. Anos depois, ele retornará ao ringue por seu filho Günes e ficará por mais um assalto.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Ressurreição conta a história da tribo Kayi, uma das tribos turcas que se afastaram das estepes da Ásia Central e que chegou aos territórios da Anatólia. Ertugrul, que tem os seus objetivos, e não tem medo de morrer pela sua religião, pela sua terra natal e pela sua família, luta contra o poder imperial do seu tempo com uma estrutura inteligente e visionária.

programme.title: Tania Maria Trio - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Tristan Live
programme.desc: Put five distinctive characters in a band bus, let them tour Europe and beyond, and let yourself be surprised by what happens along the way! “What Could Possibly Go Wrong?”, the title of Tristan’s 2021 album, aptly reflects the band’s perspective on love and life. The Dutch, five-piece band’s music is best described as feel-good vintage acid jazz, with energy, vibe, and sounds of today thrown in.

programme.title: Joe Zawinul - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. In 1985, Viennese keyboardist Joe Zawinul was one of the artists appearing at this festival.

programme.title: Al McKay's Earth, Wind And Fire Experience
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: Aki Rissanen Trio at Jazzclub Unterfahrt, Munich
programme.desc: Aki Rissanen's interest in jazz came after he started taking classical piano lessons. His deep interest in improvised music placed him among top jazz pianist in his home country - Finland. While composing and performing his own music, Rissanen has also collaborated with Verneri Pohjola and Dave Liebman, and today his name appears among the top European jazz musicians.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Keith Jarrett - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Lugano Estival Jazz is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. On July 3, 1986, American pianist and composer Keith Jarrett is joined by bassist Gary Peacock and drummer Jack DeJohnette at Estival Jazz Lugano.

programme.title: Josh Evans - Pier One Import
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, RAndB, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical.

programme.title: George Shearing Duo feat. Neil Swainson
programme.desc: British pianist George Shearing enjoyed an international reputation as an instrumentalist, arranger, and composer. Equally at home on the classical concert stage as in jazz clubs, he was recognized for his inventive, orchestrated jazz. In this live recording from the Munich Philharmonie, Shearing played in a duo format with Canadian double bassist Neil Swainson.

programme.title: Blicher Hemmer Gadd - A Music documentary
programme.desc: Award-winning saxophonist Michael Blicher, Hammond wizard Dan Hemmer and legendary drummer Steve Gadd joined forces in 2014 to celebrate their shared love for Hammond-organ soul jazz. The band, which tours extensively throughout the world, has released several albums. Their third album, which was released in November 2019, features U.K. vocalist Paul Carrack on the soulful ballad 'The First One To Know'.

programme.title: North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1978, the famed Chicago Blues All Star Band put on an electrifying performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Art Blakey Live in 1965
programme.desc: Art Blakey: Live in '65 features a very impressive lineup from jazz history: Art Blakey (drums), Jaki Byard (piano), Reggie Workman (bass), Nathan Davis (sax), and the legendary trumpet player, Freddie Hubbard. For a fall tour of Europe, Blakey assembled The New Jazzmen, a short-lived quintet that performed this legendary concert at La Mutualité in Paris on November 3, 1965.

programme.title: Alfa Jazz Festival Lviv, Ukraine
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet).

programme.title: Jon Hendricks And Company - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Billie Holiday
programme.desc: “God Bless The Child”, “Foolin’ Myself”, and “I Loves You, Porgy”: timeless songs that were made classics by the inimitable Billie Holiday. ‘Lady Day’, as her loyal friend and musical partner Lester Young nicknamed her, was a highly original jazz and pop singer. In a career that spanned most of the 1930s, 1940s and 1950s, she displayed an uncanny ability to convey emotion through her voice.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Ibrahim Maalouf
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Rhoda Scott And La Velle: Hammond, Soul and Blues
programme.desc: American soul and jazz organist Rhoda Scott spent most of her career in France, where she earned recognition far greater than that accorded to her in the United States. There was never any doubt about what instrument she would play as a child. 'It's really the most beautiful instrument in the world,” she once stated in an interview. “The first thing I did was take my shoes off and work the pedals.

programme.title: Mestrinho - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: Da Pá Virada sessions bring the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor.

programme.title: Al di Meola - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1993, American guitarist Al Di Meola was one of the artists appearing here.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Wynton Marsalis
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Tyner, Hubbard And Henderson - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Malta Jazz Festival
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn’s 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz’s future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer’s performance was a reminder of jazz’s enduring power to speak to the heart.

programme.title: Maceo Parker: Jazz à Juan
programme.desc: As a 25-year-old saxophonist, Maceo Parker played in the band of James Brown, but he is also known for his collaborations with George Clinton's Parliament-Funkadelic and Bootsy Collins' Rubber Band. Maceo has proven his star quality by creating a special chemistry between all the different styles of American black music. As a pioneer in the ‘groove’, he blends funky jazz with roots and blues with gospel. The result?

programme.title: BIRDtv: Shayna Steele
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Alfa Jazz Festival Lviv, Oekraïne
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen’s trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv’, conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen’s signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine.

programme.title: Episode 2: Dizzy Gillespie - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American jazz trumpeter, composer, and bandleader Dizzy Gillespie (1917-1993) was one of the seminal figures of the bebop movement. He fuses all musical forms rooted in African culture, such as music from Cuba, Latin America and the Caribbean, into his music.

programme.title: Face au Public: Odetta
programme.desc: Legendary African-American folk singer Odetta (1930-2008) sang her spirituals with immeasurable sorrow and anguish. Her spiritual music expresses the horrific impact of slavery on millions of African people stolen from their homeland. For Odetta, folk music—be it spirituals, blues or field songs—was a vehicle for expressing the racism and injustice experienced by black people dating back to the days of slavery.

programme.title: Travellin’ Blues: Big Daddy Wilson
programme.desc: ‘Jazz en Baie’, a whining guitar sound, and the baritone voice of Big Daddy Wilson are the perfect recipe for an emotional and melancholy blues concert. As a young man, Big Daddy Wilson never saw a real blues concert before he walked into a Bremen club as a young soldier. This revelation drove the expatriate to throw himself head over heals into music.

programme.title: Gregory Porter and Metronomy - Paris
programme.desc: In the 1960s, composer Michel Magne transformed the Château d'Hérouville, an 18th-century country house north of Paris and former home of lovers George Sand and Frédéric Chopin, into the first residential recording studio. In addition to its excellent facilities, the complex featured a swimming pool and a beautiful garden, allowing artists to stay for weeks or months at a time.

programme.title: Count Basie and his Orchestra live in Charleroi
programme.desc: Count Basie is one of the most important bandleaders of the swing era. With the exception of a brief period in the early '50s, he led a big band from 1935 until his death almost 50 years later. Basie's orchestra was characterized by a light, swinging rhythm section that he led from the piano, lively ensemble work, and generous soloing. Basie was not a composer like Duke Ellington or an important soloist like Benny Goodman.

programme.title: Mont Saint-Michel: Steve Grossman And Peter King
programme.desc: Every year, the Jazz en Baie festival takes place in the beautiful bay of Mont Saint-Michel. Today’s broadcast shows a special gathering between saxophone heavyweights Peter King and Steve Grossman. These experienced musicians’ trip to the bay amounts to much more than a social call. The quintet, which is rounded out by bass player Duylinh N'Guyen, drummer Stéphane Huchard and pianist Alain Jean-Marie, delivers an amazing show.

programme.title: Tony Bennett
programme.desc: Relive the magic of one of the most beloved crooners in music history in his prime: Tony Bennett! Recorded live in London’s Royal Albert Hall on March 2, 1974, this enchanting performance showcases Bennett's remarkable vocal prowess and charisma to full effect.

programme.title: Rumble
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Come Twogether ft. Benjamin Herman
programme.desc: Instead of children’s songs, the sound of jazz standards was always present. They practiced intricate drum rhythms instead of Bach etudes: Simon Oslender and Jérôme Cardynaals have jazz running through their veins! Under the name ‘Twogether’ both youngsters celebrate a very unique and soulful style of funky blues-jazz. They create a sound that leaves even renowned jazz artists speechless.

programme.title: Lonely Lady
programme.desc: Regarded as the greatest instrumental soloist of all-time, Stanley Gayetzky, famously known as Stan Getz emerged as one of the most significant musical forces in the world of jazz post World War II. With his distinctively warm and lyrical tone, Getz is fondly dubbed as ‘The Sound’ because of his singularity and musical innovations.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Anita Oday Live in Sweden 1963
programme.desc: Anita O’Day?boasts two wonderful concerts from 1963 and 1970 that present the “jazz singer supreme” in impeccable form. O’Day’s horn-based approach to singing is in full effect throughout both shows including stand-out renditions in each show of audience favorites “Tea For Two” and “Sweet Georgia Brown” (both reprised from her triumphant appearance at the 1958 Newport Jazz Festival.

programme.title: Sarah Vaughan Live in '58 And 64: The Divine One
programme.desc: Sarah Vaughan: Live in '58 And 64 features the ‘Divine One’ in her prime, wrapping her sultry voice around jazz standards such as ‘Lover Man’, ‘Misty’ and ‘I Got Rhythm’ and soaring on popular showtunes such as ‘Over The Rainbow’ and ‘Maria’. One of the greatest voices of the 20th Century, her renditions of songs by Harold Arlen, Leonard Bernstein, Johnny Burke, the Gershwins and Stephen Sondheim are pure diva magic.

programme.title: Smooth Series at NSJ: George Benson And Kenny G
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: Teddy Wilson - Théâtre de l’Atelier
programme.desc: Decades after the 1930s swing era came to an end, one of its giants, pianist Teddy Wilson (1912–1986), kept the flame of this music alive during countless international concert tours. During a hectic spring tour of Europe, the acclaimed pianist appeared at Geneva’s Théâtre de l’Atelier on March 21, 1969.

programme.title: Dilemma
programme.desc: Formed in 1952 from the rhythm section of Dizzy Gillespie's big band, the Modern Jazz Quartet took its inspiration from classical chamber music as well as jazz's blues roots. The group enjoyed a decades-long career with multiple critically acclaimed albums, cementing their place in the history of the genre.

programme.title: Scott DuBois Quartet Live In Munich
programme.desc: Rising star of the jazz guitar Scott DuBois leads his quartet, consisting of Gebhard Ullmann (reeds), Thomas Morgan (bass), and Kresten Osgood (drums), in an intimate and atmospheric performance at Munich’s Jazz Club Unterfahrt in March 2016. The group’s telepathy is such that they are able to go from deathly quiet to fiercely avant-garde at the drop of a hat.

programme.title: Face au Public: Odetta
programme.desc: Legendary African-American folk singer Odetta (1930-2008) sang her spirituals with immeasurable sorrow and anguish. Her spiritual music expresses the horrific impact of slavery on millions of African people stolen from their homeland. For Odetta, folk music—be it spirituals, blues or field songs—was a vehicle for expressing the racism and injustice experienced by black people dating back to the days of slavery.

programme.title: China Moses: 'Whatever' at Jazz à Ramatuelle
programme.desc: In 1988, Dee Dee Bridgewater was one of the first great jazz singers to perform at the Jazz Festival in Ramatuelle. In 2016, the story seems to repeat itself as her daughter China Moses took the stage at Ramatuelle. Over the years, China Moses has become a mature performer with a unique style: rocky voice, sharp sense of swing, and intense/energetic stage presence.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Richard Bona
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Buddy Rich and his Big Band at North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: Buddy Rich: Live in '78 highlights the relentless power and unparalleled artistry of the man who was known as ‘The World’s Greatest Drummer.’ This concert, taped in Holland in 1978, showcases one of the tightest big bands in history, featuring acclaimed saxophonist Steve Marcus and other members of Buddy’s ‘Killer Force,’ the group he would later call ‘the best band I ever had.

programme.title: Miriam Makeba Live at Estival Lugano 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Miriam Makeba, also named Mama Africa, was a South African singer, actress, United Nations goodwill ambassador, and civil-rights activist.

programme.title: Kurhaus Scheveningen: Beets And Rosenwinkel
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who was a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Woody Herman's Swinging Herd live in England 1964
programme.desc: Woody Herman: Live in '64 features a blistering one-hour concert from 1964 showcasing one of the very hottest line-ups of the 'Swinging Herd,' including trumpeter Bill Chase, trombonist Phil Wilson, and the amazing saxophonist Sal Nistico on the front line, as well as drummer Jake Hanna, bassist Chuck Andrus, and pianist-arranger Nat Pierce in the rhythm section.

programme.title: McCoy Tyner Trio live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. McCoy Tyner’s first main exposure came with Benny Golson, being the first pianist in Golson’s and Art Farmer’s Jazztet.

programme.title: Runtown - La Machine de Moulin Rouge
programme.desc: Enjoy Runtown’s first concert in Paris, where the Nigerian superstar brings many guests to his show. One of the most talented Nigerian afrobeat scenes will make you rediscover his greatest hits. Nigeria is a very creative country when it comes to the music scene. Runtown is no exception. His first single, “Party Like It’s 1980,” paved the way for “Gallardo,” which caught the entire international scene's attention.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Hypnotic Brass Ensemble - Jazzwoche Burghausen
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: Comblain-la-Tour Jazz Festival: Jimmy McGriff Trio
programme.desc: As one of the best Hammond B3 organ players, Jimmy McGriff (1936-2008) is often lost among great soul-jazz organists from his hometown of Philadelphia. Of the major soul-jazz pioneers, he was the bluesiest and often insisted that he was more of a blues musician than a jazz artist. Regardless, he remained eclectic enough to blur the lines of genres.

programme.title: Herbie Mann - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: The Crusaders: Estival Lugano 1987
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The Crusaders, an American jazz fusion group that was popular in the '70s employed a two-manned front-line horn section.

programme.title: Salomao Soares Trio - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: Da Pá Virada sessions bring the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor.

programme.title: Carrie Smith
programme.desc: Veteran American blues and jazz singer Carrie Smith (1925-2012) was often compared to the legendary Bessie Smith, an artist she greatly admired. She was best known in Europe for her powerful, resonant voice, impeccable timing, and the emotional depth she brought to her songs.

programme.title: Morgenland: Songs Without Frontiers
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects.

programme.title: Troy 'Trombone Shorty' Andrews: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz phenomenon Trombone Shorty dishes out a mix of funk, jazz, hip-hop and soul at this concert at the French festival Jazz à Vienne. Playing with the energy of a rock star, Troy Andrews, a.k.a. ‘Trombone Shorty’, pays homage to jazz legends. With his hypnotic performance and boundless energy, Trombone Shorty puts up an unparalleled performance.

programme.title: MEGA Fights In 60 T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: MEGA Fights are premiere events from the sport of boxing including HBO World Championship Boxing and historic PPV events plus past, current and future World Champions. This episode features The Ring Magazine's 2011 Fight of The Year from the Foxwoods Resort in Mashantucket, Connecticut, USA.

programme.title: Greatest Classics T1 - Ep. 40
programme.desc: FIGHT SPORTS presents another exciting Greatest Classics episode, bringing you more action featuring the greatest fighters in boxing history. From the famed Blue Horizon in Philadelphia, one of the greatest venues for boxing in the world, two heavyweight prospects square off as Courage Tshabalala of South Africa takes on Virginia native Darroll Wilson.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! T1 - Ep. 38
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is the undefeated Keith Thurman facing off with Orlando Lora. A left hook and right uppercut combination ends this fight. Also on the card, action from former heavyweight champion James Kirkland.

programme.title: FS Grand Sumo T11 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: For the first time the top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. This new format presents Sumo in an authentic, in-depth and entertaining way covering the rules, ranks, match-ups, and more. Show 5 featuring Kisenosato, Kotoshogiku, Harumafuji and Hakuho from the Aki basho, 2015.

programme.title: BWF Martial Arts T10 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: This episode features highlights from the Men's Weapons Championship at the ISKA US Open Championships held at Disney World, Orlando, FL, USA.

programme.title: Wide World of Fights T3 - Ep. 33
programme.desc: This episode features Arturo Gatti facing Alfonso Gomez in what would be Gatti's final pro boxing bout, as well as kickboxing, sumo and more!

programme.title: FIGHT SPORTS MMA T2025 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: In this episode Mark Hulme takes on Ziko 'The Gorilla' Makengele for the World Welterweight Championship.

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior T6 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: In the season premiere, dozens of contestants from across the west coast will compete on a redesigned course, featuring new obstacles like the Spinning Wheel, Slack Ladder and Jumping Bars!

programme.desc: The main event in this episode is a WBC welterweight title bout between Floyd Mayweather, Jr. and Victor Ortiz, which generated $78 million in pay-per-view revenue from 1.25 million buys. Also on the card, action from super welterweight champ James Kirkland and Alfredo Angulo.

programme.title: Judo for the World T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Judo for the World features the best competitors in the sport as they compete in a global tour for an opportunity to vie for the gold in the World Judo Championship. In this episode, we see the best of the Judo Grand Slam from Paris as some of the 2016 Olympics' finest athletes battle for their shot at glory.

programme.title: Wide World of Fights T3 - Ep. 51
programme.desc: This episode features Jhonny Gonzalez defending his WBO bantamweight title against Gerry Penalosa, as well as kickboxing, sumo, weapons and more!

programme.title: Harceleur
programme.desc: Camille est professeur dans un collège d’une ville pavillonnaire, son fils Mathias est en 3ème dans le même établissement. Des faits de harcèlement lui sont signalés et, avant qu’elle n’ait le temps d’en comprendre l’ampleur et d’agir, l’élève harcelé fait une tentative de suicide et tombe dans le coma. Les parents, les autres élèves, tout le monde est sous le choc.

programme.title: Lindsay, la Mécanique du Harcèlement
programme.desc: Comment en une année scolaire à peine Lindsay, une fille de 13 ans, joyeuse, populaire, a-t-elle pu se suicider ? Qui aurait pu arrêter la mécanique infernale du harcèlement à l'école et sur les réseaux sociaux ? Ce film retrace les derniers mois de la vie de la jeune fille, aux côtés de ses proches et s'interroge sur le sens de la responsabilité collective : pourquoi ce drame aurait dû être évité, que faut-il mettre en place pour...

programme.title: On Aboie en Silence
programme.desc: Adaptation du livre ' Ensemble on aboie en silence' écrit par Gringe et son frère. C'est un récit autour de la schizophrénie de Thibault le petit frère de Gringe : comment la maladie est apparue, comment elle a été combattue par la fratrie et plus largement la famille pour qu'au final Thibault l'accepte et vive avec.

programme.desc: Réalisé par Axelle Ropert Avec Mélanie Bernier, Bastien Bouillon Lorsqu'ils se rencontrent dans l'ascenseur, Théo ne voit pas qu'Élise est non voyante. Ils se détestent immédiatement. L'amour prend son temps. Est-ce que ce malentendu initial va les rapprocher ou les éloigner?..

programme.title: Caprice
programme.desc: Réalisé par Emmanuel Mouret Avec Virginie Efira, Anaïs Demoustier, Laurent Stocker Un homme ordinaire rencontre une actrice plus belle qu'il ne pourrait l'imaginer. Mais une fille agaçante se matérialise alors pour faire de sa vie un enfer...

programme.title: Music.box
programme.desc: C’est un duo étonnant : Jean-Yves, la cinquantaine, 30 ans de musique derrière lui et un vrai talent de compositeur. Elle, c’est Amalia et une voix qui décoiffe ! Sur scène, ils ne sont que tous les 2, mais leur électro-rock, à la fois novateur et très 'années 80', est à la fois dynamique et mystérieux... À l’image de leur nouvel album intitulé 'La nuit et le jour'.

programme.title: Emporte la Nuit
programme.desc: Réalisation : Sami Battikh Production : Sourdoreille Production Un live qui commence en pleine nuit et se termine en plein jour, c’est le défi que propose la collection Emporte La Nuit. Après les sessions d’Aliocha Schneider et Solann, c’est au tour d’Emma Peters de nous embarquer dans son univers solaire.

programme.title: Les Rencontres du Papotin
programme.desc: Une emission moderee par Julien Bancilhon Avec la participation de toute la redaction du Papotin Une emission proposee par Olivier Nakache et Eric Toledano Realisation : Henri Poulain Une coproduction Kiosco.TV et Quad+TEN Producteurs : Clement Chovin Tristan Carne Jerome Lament Nicolas Duval Adassovsky Herve Ruet Productrice editoriale : Florence Chataignier Mars Marion Cotillard face à la rédaction du Papotin.

programme.title: Top Comedy Club
programme.desc: Production: Kader Aoun Productions Production exécutive: Olivier Rodot Réalisation: Thierry Gautier et Sylvain Leduc Animation: Mathieu Madénian Ce programme humoristique braque les projecteurs sur une toute nouvelle génération de comiques.

programme.title: Hommage à Jerome Robbins (À l'opéra National de Paris - Opéra...

programme.title: Família Dumbo
programme.desc: A Família Dumbo chega à Kanuca TV trazendo o retrato divertido e emocionante de uma família típica de Benguela, onde cada episódio transforma desafios do dia-a-dia em histórias cheias de humor, valores e identidade angolana.
